headline: Rotation day: the Dow gains 1.0% and the Russell 2000 1.65% as health care hits a record, while the Nasdaq ends flat

notes.text: Money rotated out of megacap tech: the Dow rose 1.02% to 52,495.88 and the Russell 2000 1.65% to 2,773.41, while the S&P 500 added 0.28% to 7,712.57 and the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.02% to 26,424.82.

Health care led and the XLV fund closed at a record: XLV +2.37%, Eli Lilly +3.49%, UnitedHealth +3.04%, Moderna +6.69%. Real estate (+1.70%) and utilities (+1.26%) also beat the market; tech (XLK) fell 0.28%.
Earnings beats did not save the industrials: GM fell 6.84% despite adjusted EPS of $3.70 and a $20B buyback, and GE fell 3.67% after raising its 2026 EPS outlook to $8.00-$8.10.
Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for $47.50 a share in cash, about $5.66B; Braze jumped 51.7% to $45.57.
A broad rally: among US stocks over $5 with more than $5M traded, 2,990 rose and 991 fell, and 22 S&P 500 members touched a 52-week high vs 1 at a low.
